lyrics:
[Intro: analog synth pad, slapped bass, drum machine fill]

[Verse 1: soft male falsetto]
Top down, twenty-five
Every light on the strip is pink
That one was the Fontaine, that one was a dive
I was nineteen, I couldn't think

[Pre-Chorus: synth brass rising]
You never saw it then
Let me show you now

[Chorus: full groove, falsetto stacked]
Collins after dark
Slow enough to read the signs
Your hand out, riding the warm air
Mine on yours, taking my time
Collins after dark
Nowhere we have to park

[Verse 2: falsetto, bass popping]
Same moon, different names
Valet where the bait shop stood
I don't need it to stay the same
I just need the night to be good

[Pre-Chorus: synth brass rising]
You weren't with me then
You're with me now

[Chorus: full groove, falsetto stacked]
Collins after dark
Slow enough to read the signs
Your hand out, riding the warm air
Mine on yours, taking my time
Collins after dark
Nowhere we have to park

[Sax Solo: smooth tenor sax over the groove]

[Final Chorus: full groove, sax answering]
Collins after dark
Slow enough to read the signs
Your hand out, riding the warm air
Mine on yours, taking my time
Collins after dark
Nowhere we have to park

[Outro: synth pad, engine idling, surf far off]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 115 BPM, 4/4, B-flat minor. A smooth, gliding, mid-tempo night groove with a 1980s gloss.

VOICE: Male falsetto, soft, breathy and intimate, stacked in three-part harmony in the choruses. No chest-voice belting anywhere.

INSTRUMENTS: Warm analogue-style synth pads and a bright synth-brass line, a slapped and popped electric bass, a 1980s drum machine with a gated snare, a clean chorused rhythm guitar, a tenor saxophone solo, electric piano, soft bongos.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, pad and bass. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:40 Pre-chorus. 0:48 Chorus 1. 1:14 Verse 2. 1:40 Pre-chorus. 1:48 Chorus 2. 2:14 Sax solo. 2:30 Final chorus. 2:58 Outro, pad, engine and surf, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2015 nu-disco with 1985 Miami colours: glossy, wide and warm, gated reverb on the snare, bass and falsetto in front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The saxophone entering at 2:14.

STATION FIT: 9 p.m., after dinner. The station's most Miami track: neon, mid-tempo, built for a slow drive along the beach road.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Nostalgic, tender, unhurried, content.
